title: You can view a role's Permission Summary from Edit Staff Member using the eye icon next to the Role dropdown
preconds:
1. Log in as a user who can edit staff (for example an Administrator).
  2. At least one staff member exists.
steps:
1. Go to the Staff page (Settings > Staff).
  2. Open a staff member to bring up the Edit Staff Member window.
  3. Find the Role dropdown and the eye icon next to it.
  4. Click the eye icon.
expected:
There is an eye icon next to the Role dropdown on the Edit Staff Member window.

Clicking it opens a read-only Permission Summary for the role currently chosen in the dropdown.

The summary lists that role's permissions with no way to edit them.
